bio: Enjoy everyday luxury and escape to Victors with our modern Asian inspired menu and show stopping cocktails served under the iconic wisteria trees.  Beautiful, vibrant, upscale yet informal, Victors Alderley Edge is the perfect restaurant for everything from celebrations to intimate dining and group bookings. Located along London Road, right in the heart of Alderley Edge village.  Introducing Afternoon Tea #TheVictorsWay. Experience simply the best Afternoon Tea in Alderley Edge. Indulge in a delightful selection of homemade luxury treats, from classic sandwiches including Avocado Hummus & Feta Brioche roll to an array of sweet desserts including Victors Chocolate & Hazelnut Cookie.  Served at your table with sparklers and dry ice, Afternoon Tea at Victors is like no other.
